summary: Implemented prepareUpdate and the Update container, per the spec. Changes: (1) rdflib/plugins/sparql/sparql.py adds an Update class with prologue and algebra attributes, placed beside Query. (2) rdflib/plugins/sparql/algebra.py: translateUpdate always returns an Update. The empty-request path translates q.prologue[0] with base and initNs and returns an empty algebra list. The non-empty loop is unchanged apart from wrapping its result; Update is imported alongside Prologue and Query. (3) rdflib/plugins/sparql/update.py: evalUpdate iterates update.algebra and its docstring says it takes an Update container. (4) rdflib/plugins/sparql/processor.py adds prepareUpdate(updateString, initNs={}, base=None), mirroring prepareQuery and recording _original_args; the processor's update method is unchanged. (5) rdflib/plugins/sparql/__init__.py exports prepareUpdate. (6) test/test_sparql_prepare.py is new and covers the required behaviors, including a no-mutation check. Choices: on the empty path the prologue is built inside the early-return branch; the no-mutation snapshot uses [op.name, str(op)] per operation. Not verified: I did not run tests or black, per instructions. Side effect to note: pprintAlgebra (debug output in the DAWG runner) now prints the algebra as a plain list. Nothing was committed.
